These patches truly make my pimples disappear, no red spots or anything, it's like they never happened
I've used a lot of pimple patches, but these really are next level. If you're skeptical, don't be!!

These are definitely the best patches I've used. They work best over night for me- if I pop a pimple and cover it with one of these patches after, it is pretty much gone by morning and really speeds up the healing process!
These are my favorite blemish patches ever!! Nice an thin but get the job done

These patches really stick to your skin...so when you try to remove the patch it pulls on your skin so much that it tears your skin and starts to bleed...I do not recommend these patches. The adhesion needs to be modified asap.
Genuinely the most effective pimple patches I've tried. Brings the pimple right to the surface or makes it disappear all together. Really been a lifesaver! I just love Personal Day!!!
I really like those patches. they dry the pimples so quickly and you get rid of them in a day
I love love love the All Covered patches both to help heal and reduce redness overnight and to use under makeup by day. I feel like I'm covered, pun intended, 24/7, whatever I'm up to.
Appreciate the packaging on Personal Day products, and the matte texture!

These have been a game changer. I've gotten three of my friends to use these now from giving them as gifts. I've had trouble with cystic acne for years and the coating on these makes a major difference. Will forever be a supporter of this line!

I have used pimple patches for 5-6 years now and these work noticeably better than the generic brands and mighty patches I had used previously! I notice my pimples not only decrease in size/intensity after using, but also tend to heal faster and have less scarring with the PD patches. I'm on my fifth or sixth pack now and will continue to reorder!
Stayed on through the night which was huge for me and I love how sometimes I completely forget its on because it blends amazingly.
I've tried so many other brands but these are the best at absorbing excess oil etc and leaving the pimple much calmer and smoother (less inflammation)

I had been using the Hero brand pimple patches for awhile but they do not work as well as these. I can see a noticeable difference before and after I use these patches. They stick really well to my face as well so they don't fall off as easily as other ones I have tried. Love how transparent they are as well, hardly notice that they are on!
I am so pleased with this product. It is so amazing! I can put a patch on at night and by the next morning the blemish is on it's way to healing. The patches are also very invisible on the skin.

These work amazingly well- I used three of them overnight (I was breaking out really badly), and by the time I woke up, the pimples were almost completely flattened. I did take off one star because these were really painful to remove- I don't know if they have super strong adhesion or something, but I've never had any other patches hurt like that. But the results are worth it.

Honestly felt like these are just like every other blemish patch I've tried. One thing I did like was how well they blend in with my skin, I feel like I can wear them during the daytime and they aren't obvious.
The best pimple patches I have ever tried! They blend so nicely too
These are the best pimple patches I have used. I used to be loyal to a different brand until i got these included in my order. These are now my new go-to for any blemish on my face or back.
my fave blemish patches—they actually make the blemish go away, not just cover it up

my pimple patch allegiance was to hero cosmetics for a long time until i tried personal days! these are longer lasting & don't fall or start to peel off in the daytime or if i wear them at night. pops & reduces pimple size effectively, while also being majorly unnoticeable. a must have for my acne prone, sensitive skin! my only complaint is, if you have longer nails, that because the patches are thicker they can catch & sometimes fold in on themselves or crease when unsticking them from the sheet. more user error than anything though!

I wanted tl love these, as an Ulta employee highly recommended. However, the sheets are not perforated like the HERO brand that I always buy. I ended up wasting several patches because while trying to cleanly pull a patch off of the sheet, they ended up sticking to itself and you absolutely cannot fix that once it happens. For this reason, I do not recommend this brand.

This product does not work as intended. The patches stick TOO well and will peel off any baby facial hair you have. It also peeled of the top layer of my skin. Now trying to keep it from scarring. Hero Patches have never done this to me.

There is seriously something special about these patches! I love them and they work so well!! I have never used one under my makeup so I can not attest to its invisibility under makeup, however let me tell you these patches work! On several occasions I've put this patch on in the evening and left it on overnight and by morning the zits are completely gone! (for some really stubborn acne it takes a couple days/patches). I have tried many patches and none of them have worked quite like these do. I highly recommend, I will be purchasing again and again.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy these again! Game changer!
avis.texte: When they are on they are almost undetectable. I left them on for 8 hrs + and when I took them off the blemish was considerably better. It also didn't dry out my skin to the point that it peeled.

I've tried a few different pimple patch brands and they all look terrible and super noticable under makeup, but these are barely visible. They also actually stay stuck all day, compared to other brands that start to lift or will fall off. A little pricey but worth it
I've ordered several of these. They've worked so well for me I don't want to go without

I will repurchase these as long as I can! I have hormonal acne in my late 20s that makes my cycle UNBEARABLE. These help by covering, shrinking, and HIDING underneath makeup imperceptibly. Highly recommend :)
Love the sizes of these patches, and they are less noticeable on the skin than some other brands!! They stick really well, almost too well!
This product is easy to use and has great results! They stay on really well too

I've used many pimple patches over the years and never really had an opinion about any of them until I used these. These are hands down my favorite and I won't be using any other kind again. These work SO fast, they are basically invisible, and (in my opinion) remove ALL the gunk out of your pours. I've gone to bed with large red/white bumps and woken up with nothing left in its spot. I can't recommend these patches enough!

I find these are much more visible than Hero's invisible patches and the backing isn't scored so they're hard to remove without bunching up the edges, which makes them even more visible. I think the lighting in the ads makes it look like they disappear into your skin but they don't.
Literally wore it to work without realizing it and by the time I took it off the blemish had dramatically shrunk.

I really wanted to like these, especially since I love personal day products, but these did not work for me. If anything, they made my pimple more active. I put this on a pimple that was emerging and the next day it turned out to be an active pimple. Maybe the patches are too strong for me as I have sensitive skin!
These patches are incredible. Not only do they fully pull everything out in one patch, but they don't leave behind a red mark/scar the way some other patches do!
I tried these last night and im thoroughly impressed. They do an excellent job. You can tell they are made well and they stayed put throughout the night. Worth the splurge
These are the most invisible pimple patches I've tried so far. They work pretty well too. Kind of expensive but worth it so far!

Ive been using other pimple patches for months and once I switched to these, my skin became more red and very very dry. I really wanted to like these since I LOVE the other Personal Day products and use them daily. Unfortunately, these are just too strong for sensitive skin like mine.
These pinple patches are so good. It cuts my healing time from acne in half!! Theyre also invisible compared to others on the market so you can wear them in public and no one would be able to tell!
I'm used to my go-to patches that are much cheaper, but was shocked to see how much faster these patches healed my cystic pimple. Bonus points for being so invisible under makeup!

This product has revolutionized my acne treatment. First and foremost, they are completely invisible, even on the most severe breakouts. Secondly, they stay on the skin throughout the day. Lastly, they have the remarkable ability to heal even the most stubborn pimples, including single cystic acne spots that crop up under the surface. Definitely a superior product to any other pimple patch on the market!
